update_log: Baseline initialization of high-frequency 'First in India' data, categorized by Male, Female, and General milestones for Miscellaneous Static GK.

first_in_india_male.title: First President of India
first_in_india_male.name: Dr. Rajendra Prasad
first_in_india_male.key_fact: The longest-serving President in Indian history, serving two consecutive terms.

first_in_india_male.title: First Prime Minister of India
first_in_india_male.name: Jawaharlal Nehru
first_in_india_male.key_fact: The longest-serving Prime Minister of India. He died in office in 1964.

first_in_india_male.title: First Indian to win a Nobel Prize
first_in_india_male.name: Rabindranath Tagore
first_in_india_male.key_fact: Won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1913 for his collection of poems, 'Gitanjali'.

first_in_india_male.title: First Chief Election Commissioner of India
first_in_india_male.name: Sukumar Sen
first_in_india_male.key_fact: Successfully oversaw India's first two general elections in 1951–52 and 1957.

first_in_india_male.title: First Indian in Space
first_in_india_male.name: Rakesh Sharma
first_in_india_male.key_fact: Flew aboard the Soviet spacecraft Soyuz T-11 in 1984. Famously described India from space as 'Sare Jahan Se Achha'.

first_in_india_male.title: First Field Marshal of India
first_in_india_male.name: Sam Manekshaw
first_in_india_male.key_fact: Led the Indian Army during the successful Indo-Pakistani War of 1971.

first_in_india_male.title: First Indian to swim across the English Channel
first_in_india_male.name: Mihir Sen
first_in_india_male.key_fact: Achieved this feat in 1958. He is also the only man to swim the oceans of the five continents in one calendar year.

first_in_india_female.title: First Woman President of India
first_in_india_female.name: Pratibha Patil
first_in_india_female.key_fact: Served as the 12th President of India from 2007 to 2012.

first_in_india_female.title: First Woman Prime Minister of India
first_in_india_female.name: Indira Gandhi
first_in_india_female.key_fact: The first and, to date, the only female Prime Minister of India.

first_in_india_female.title: First Woman Governor of an Indian State
first_in_india_female.name: Sarojini Naidu
first_in_india_female.key_fact: Known as the 'Nightingale of India'. She became the Governor of the United Provinces (now Uttar Pradesh) in 1947.

first_in_india_female.title: First Woman Chief Minister of an Indian State
first_in_india_female.name: Sucheta Kripalani
first_in_india_female.key_fact: Served as the head of the Uttar Pradesh government from 1963 to 1967.

first_in_india_female.title: First Woman Judge of the Supreme Court
first_in_india_female.name: Justice M. Fathima Beevi
first_in_india_female.key_fact: Appointed to the Supreme Court in 1989. She was also the first Muslim woman to be appointed to any higher judiciary.

first_in_india_female.title: First Woman IPS Officer
first_in_india_female.name: Kiran Bedi
first_in_india_female.key_fact: Joined the Indian Police Service in 1972 and later served as the Lieutenant Governor of Puducherry.

first_in_india_female.title: First Indian Woman in Space
first_in_india_female.name: Kalpana Chawla
first_in_india_female.key_fact: Flew on the Space Shuttle Columbia in 1997. Tragically died in the Columbia disaster in 2003.

first_in_india_female.title: First Indian Woman to win an Olympic Medal
first_in_india_female.name: Karnam Malleswari
first_in_india_female.key_fact: Won a Bronze medal in Weightlifting (69 kg category) at the 2000 Sydney Olympics.

first_in_india_general_and_events.title: First Artificial Satellite
first_in_india_general_and_events.key_fact: Named after the prominent Indian astronomer and mathematician. It was launched by the Soviet Union.

first_in_india_general_and_events.title: First Nuclear Test
first_in_india_general_and_events.key_fact: Conducted at the Pokhran Test Range in Rajasthan, making India the sixth country in the world to successfully test a nuclear weapon.

first_in_india_general_and_events.title: First National Park
first_in_india_general_and_events.event_or_entity: Hailey National Park (now Jim Corbett National Park)
first_in_india_general_and_events.key_fact: Established in Uttarakhand to protect the endangered Bengal tiger.

first_in_india_general_and_events.title: First Passenger Train
first_in_india_general_and_events.key_fact: Covered a distance of 34 kilometers (21 miles) and was hauled by three steam locomotives: Sahib, Sindh, and Sultan.

first_in_india_general_and_events.title: First Post Office
first_in_india_general_and_events.key_fact: Established by Warren Hastings under the East India Company.
